verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents its own recurring schedules for specific compliance workflows: user access reviews and risk-based vendor reviews. It also lets users customize notifications for recurring tasks such as quarterly access reviews and annual pen tests. These are domain-specific schedules, not a general mechanism for scheduling arbitrary jobs or workflows. Daily continuous monitoring is built into the platform rather than user-scheduled. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of custom jobs/workflows, API- or MCP-driven schedule management, detailed docs on schedule configuration options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Designate reviewers per system and use recurring schedules, reminders, and status indicators to keep the process moving.
Users can also set up recurring reviews based on risk level, and set up tasks and notifications via Jira and Slack.
Customize notifications for required regular tasks throughout the year including quarterly user access reviews and annual penetration testing.
